铁及其化合物：铁的价态转化: Iron and Its Compounds: Changing Iron's Oxidation State
Fe³⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Fe²⁺ · 要变 +3 得靠氧化剂，要变 +2 得靠还: Fe³⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Fe²⁺ · going to +3 needs an oxidizing agent, going to +2 needs a reducing agent
同一个铁元素，为什么在试管里一会儿是 +2 价、一会儿是 +3 价，我们凭什么知: It's the same element, iron. Why is it +2 in a test tube one moment and +3 the next, and how do we know which?
+2 价和 +3 价；+3 是高价态，可以预测它有氧化性: +2 and +3; +3 is the higher state, so we can predict it is oxidizing
Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ 交出电子：O₂、氯水、稀硝酸都能做到: Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ gives up an electron: O₂, chlorine water and dilute nitric acid can all do it
Fe³⁺ → Fe²⁺ 拿回电子：过量铁粉，2 mol 变 3 mol: Fe³⁺ → Fe²⁺ takes an electron back: excess iron powder, 2 mol becomes 3 mol
KSCN 只认 Fe³⁺，「不变红」不等于「没有铁」: KSCN only detects Fe³⁺; "no red" doesn't mean "no iron"
整体 · 一张实验台上把铁的价态往上推、往下拉，再用 KSCN 认一认: Overview · on one bench, push iron's state up, pull it down, and identify it with KSCN
动一个开关，四个工位的价态、颜色与检验一起变: Flip one switch and the state, color and test at all four stations change together
全对！价态就是电子的个数：往上走要氧化剂，往下走要还原剂，KSCN 只认 +3: All correct! Oxidation state is the electron count: going up needs an oxidizer, going down needs a reducer, and KSCN only detects +3.
建议回看主线：先分清「现在是什么价态」，再看「是谁把电子拿走了 / 送回来了」，: Try reviewing the main thread: first tell "what state it is now", then "who took the electron away / brought it back", and finally "which state the test detects".

Main reading 0.0 %, color white (the FeSO₄ tube just after adding NaOH)
四个工位 · 一张实验台 · 全程不换场景: Four stations · one bench · no scene change
一个工位回答一个问题：沉淀为什么先白后红、KSCN 认谁、价态怎么来回走、食品里: Each station answers one question: why the precipitate turns from white to red, what KSCN detects, how the state moves back and forth, and how to test food for iron.
每个工位都有一支「没做这个操作」的对照管，颜色差才看得出来。: Every station has a control tube "without this step", so the color difference is visible.
界面上的 φ 是课件造的量（示意读数），教材只说颜色和现象。: The φ on screen is a quantity made up for the lesson (illustrative reading); the textbook only describes colors and observations.
去掉这一步：学生把四个实验当成四件互不相干的事，不知道它们都在回答「铁的价态走哪: Skip this step and students treat the four experiments as unrelated, not seeing they all answer "where did iron's state go".
常考：Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 的检验与相互转化；「从物质类别和元素价态预测性质」: Common exam topic: testing for and interconverting Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺; predicting properties from substance class and oxidation state.
铁在化合物里主要显 +2 价和 +3 价；从元素价态这个视角，可以预测 +3 价: In compounds iron is mainly +2 and +3. From the oxidation-state view, we can predict +3 is oxidizing, and design a reaction of iron metal with +3 iron to give +2 iron (from the textbook's method guide).
A2.1、A2.15、A3.2、B2.1 标准值表 1: A2.1, A2.15, A3.2, B2.1, standard values table 1
FeSO₄ 里滴 NaOH，沉淀为什么是白的，而且很快就不是白的了？: Why is the precipitate from adding NaOH to FeSO₄ white, and why doesn't it stay white?
把敞口静置的时间从 0 拖到 45 s 以上，盯住右边那支 FeSO₄ 管的沉淀: Drag the open standing time from 0 to over 45 s and watch the precipitate color in the right-hand FeSO₄ tube
敞口静置：0 s 白色（0.0 %）→ 10 s 灰绿色（18.1 %）→ 45: Standing open: 0 s white (0.0 %) → 10 s grey-green (18.1 %) → 45 s red-brown (59.3 %) → 120 s red-brown (90.9 %); the control tube on the left (FeCl₃ + NaOH) stays red-brown Fe(OH)₃ throughout
FeSO₄ + 2NaOH = Fe(OH)₂↓ + Na₂SO₄ · 敞口: FeSO₄ + 2NaOH = Fe(OH)₂↓ + Na₂SO₄ · open to air
「白色」是 Fe(OH)₂ 本来的颜色，不是没反应。: "White" is the true color of Fe(OH)₂, not a sign that nothing reacted.
变灰绿、变红褐是被氧化，氧来自溶解在溶液里的 O₂，不是来自 NaOH。: Turning grey-green then red-brown is oxidation; the oxygen comes from O₂ dissolved in the solution, not from NaOH.
φ 一路上升、颜色单调走下去：这就是「价态往上走」。: φ rises steadily and the color moves one way: this is "the state going up".
去掉这一步：学生会把「先白后红褐」背成两个互不相干的沉淀。: Skip this step and students memorize "white then red-brown" as two unrelated precipitates.
高频：Fe(OH)₂ 的颜色与变色原因；两个化学方程式。: Frequently tested: the color of Fe(OH)₂ and why it changes; the two chemical equations.
白色的 Fe(OH)₂ 被溶解在溶液中的氧气氧化成红褐色的 Fe(OH)₃：Fe: White Fe(OH)₂ is oxidized by oxygen dissolved in the solution to red-brown Fe(OH)₃: FeSO₄ + 2NaOH = Fe(OH)₂↓ + Na₂SO₄, 4Fe(OH)₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O = 4Fe(OH)₃ (textbook wording).
A2.6、A2.7、A2.8、B2.6、B2.7、标准值表 1–6、D2: A2.6, A2.7, A2.8, B2.6, B2.7, standard values tables 1–6, D2
想看清 Fe(OH)₂ 的白色，实验室里该怎么把空气挡住？: To see Fe(OH)₂'s white clearly, how should the lab keep air out?
把「隔绝空气」打开（煮沸除氧 + 长滴管伸入液面下 + 煤油液封），再看同样 6: Turn on "Exclude air" (boil off oxygen + long dropper below the surface + kerosene seal) and look at the precipitate after the same 60 s
同样静置 60 s：敞口是 69.9 %（红褐色）→ 隔绝后 4.7 %（白色）: After the same 60 s: open is 69.9 % (red-brown) → air excluded 4.7 % (white); even at 120 s the excluded tube only reaches 9.2 %, still white. On the graph the solid line (open) and dashed line (excluded) separate
隔绝空气：煮沸除氧 · 长滴管伸入液面下 · 煤油液封: Exclude air: boil off oxygen · long dropper below the surface · kerosene seal
挡住的不是 NaOH，是空气里的 O₂。: What's blocked isn't NaOH; it's the O₂ in air.
三个动作各挡一路：煮沸赶走溶解氧、长滴管不让它接触空气、煤油把液面封住。: Each of the three actions blocks one route: boiling drives off dissolved oxygen, the long dropper avoids contact with air, kerosene seals the surface.
曲线图上实线（敞口）与虚线（隔绝）分开，就是这一步的对照。: The solid line (open) and dashed line (excluded) separating on the graph is the control for this step.
去掉这一步：学生以为「Fe(OH)₂ 就是会变色」，不知道这是可以防的。: Skip this step and students think "Fe(OH)₂ just changes color", not knowing it can be prevented.
高频：实验室制 Fe(OH)₂ 为什么要隔绝空气、具体怎么做。: Frequently tested: why preparing Fe(OH)₂ in the lab requires excluding air, and exactly how.
先煮沸除氧、用长滴管把 NaOH 伸到液面下滴加、再用煤油封住液面，白色沉淀就能: Boil the water to remove oxygen, add NaOH with a long dropper below the surface, then seal the surface with kerosene, and the white precipitate stays (the textbook only asks "how to obtain Fe(OH)₂"; these three steps are lesson settings).
A2.9、A4.2、B2.6、标准值表 7–9、D1: A2.9, A4.2, B2.6, standard values tables 7–9, D1
两支管都滴了 KSCN，为什么只有一支变红？: Both tubes got KSCN. Why does only one turn red?
各滴几滴 KSCN，看 FeCl₃ 对照管和 FeCl₂ 实验管哪一支变红: Add a few drops of KSCN to each and see which turns red: the FeCl₃ control or the FeCl₂ sample
FeCl₃ 对照管（100.0 %）→ 红色；FeCl₂ 实验管（0.0 %）→: FeCl₃ control (100.0 %) → red; FeCl₂ sample (0.0 %) → no red, still pale green, c(Fe³⁺) = 0 mmol/L
Fe³⁺ + KSCN → 红色（Fe²⁺ 不变红）: Fe³⁺ + KSCN → red (Fe²⁺ doesn't turn red)
FeCl₃ 对照管 → FeCl₂ 实验管 · 各滴几滴 KSCN: FeCl₃ control → FeCl₂ sample · a few drops of KSCN each
不变红不等于没有铁：FeCl₂ 管里明明是铁，只是价态是 +2 价。: No red doesn't mean no iron: the FeCl₂ tube clearly contains iron, just in the +2 state.
这一条是第 8 步「误判」的根：所有「不变红就说不含铁」的结论都错在这里。: This is the root of the "misjudgment" in step 8: every "no red, so no iron" conclusion goes wrong here.
去掉这一步：学生会用 KSCN 去「检验铁元素」，一考就反。: Skip this step and students use KSCN to "test for the element iron" and get it backwards on the exam.
高频：检验 Fe³⁺ 用什么试剂、现象是什么；Fe²⁺ 为什么不变红。: Frequently tested: which reagent tests for Fe³⁺ and what you see; why Fe²⁺ doesn't turn red.
含有 Fe³⁺ 的盐溶液遇到 KSCN 溶液时变成红色，可以利用这一反应检验 F: Salt solutions containing Fe³⁺ turn red with KSCN solution, and this reaction can be used to test for Fe³⁺ (textbook wording).
A2.11、A2.12、A3.3、B2.5、标准值表 10–12、D3: A2.11, A2.12, A3.3, B2.5, standard values tables 10–12, D3
加一勺铁粉，为什么红色会褪成浅绿？: Why does the red fade to pale green when you add a spoonful of iron powder?
往转化管里加入过量铁粉，振荡后看主读数、颜色和 KSCN 检验怎么一起变: Add excess iron powder to the conversion tube, shake, and watch the main reading, color and KSCN test change together
主读数 100.0 → 0.0 %；c(Fe³⁺)/c(Fe²⁺) 由 50 /: Main reading 100.0 → 0.0 %; c(Fe³⁺)/c(Fe²⁺) goes from 50 / 0 → 0 / 75 mmol/L; the solution fades from red to pale green and the KSCN test flips from "red" to "not red". The control tube on the left (FeCl₃ with KSCN only) stays red
FeCl₃ 溶液 + 过量铁粉 · 再滴 KSCN: FeCl₃ solution + excess iron powder · then KSCN
褪色是因为 Fe³⁺ 被还原掉了，不是被稀释。: The fading is because Fe³⁺ is reduced, not diluted.
2 mol Fe³⁺ 变成 3 mol Fe²⁺：c(Fe²⁺) 从 0 涨到: 2 mol Fe³⁺ becomes 3 mol Fe²⁺: c(Fe²⁺) rises from 0 to 75 mmol/L, more than the original 50. The ratio comes from the equation, not a setting.
教材是加铁粉充分反应后再滴 KSCN；本课先滴是为了看见红色褪去的过程，结论相同: The textbook adds iron powder, lets it react fully, then adds KSCN; this lesson adds KSCN first so you can watch the red fade. The conclusion is the same (once Fe³⁺ is reduced, KSCN no longer shows red).
去掉这一步：学生只会背「加铁粉褪色」，答不出为什么褪、褪成什么价。: Skip this step and students only memorize "iron powder fades it", unable to say why or to what state.
高频：除去 FeCl₂ 溶液中的 Fe³⁺ 用什么、离子方程式；现象怎么写。: Frequently tested: what removes Fe³⁺ from FeCl₂ solution and the ionic equation; how to describe the observations.
2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺——铁盐遇到较强的还原剂会被还原成亚铁盐（教: 2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺: iron(III) salts are reduced to iron(II) salts by stronger reducing agents (textbook wording + ionic equation).
A2.13、A2.14、B2.8、标准值表 12–13、D4: A2.13, A2.14, B2.8, standard values tables 12–13, D4
浅绿色的清液里滴几滴氯水，颜色和 KSCN 检验为什么一起变了？: Why do the color and the KSCN test both change when you add a few drops of chlorine water to the pale green liquid?
把上层清液倒出来，滴几滴氯水，再看主读数、颜色和 KSCN 检验: Pour off the supernatant, add a few drops of chlorine water, then look at the main reading, color and KSCN test
主读数 0.0 → 100.0 %；c 由 0 / 75 → 75 / 0 mm: Main reading 0.0 → 100.0 %; c goes from 0 / 75 → 75 / 0 mmol/L; the solution goes from pale green → yellow-brown and the KSCN test flips back from "not red" to "red"; and 75 mmol/L is 50 % higher than the original 50
上层清液 + 几滴氯水 · 再滴 KSCN: Supernatant + a few drops of chlorine water · then KSCN
氯水是「较强氧化剂」，把价态往上提。: Chlorine water is a "stronger oxidizer" that pushes the state up.
这次变红比一开始更深，因为加铁粉那一步有铁粉溶解进来（总铁 50 → 75 mm: The red is deeper than at the start because iron powder dissolved in the previous step (total iron 50 → 75 mmol/L); chlorine water only oxidizes all 75 of Fe²⁺ back to 75 of Fe³⁺. The state changes, total iron doesn't.
教材的做法是「把上层清液倒入另一支试管」再加氯水：原管里还有铁粉，加进去会被铁粉: The textbook "pours the supernatant into another tube" before adding chlorine water: the original tube still has iron powder, which would use it up first.
去掉这一步：学生以为「铁粉把铁除掉了」，不知道它只是把价态改了。: Skip this step and students think "the iron powder removed the iron", not seeing it only changed the state.
高频：Fe²⁺ 的检验（先氧化再滴 KSCN）；氯水的作用；两步的离子方程式。: Frequently tested: testing for Fe²⁺ (oxidize first, then KSCN); the role of chlorine water; ionic equations for both steps.
2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻——亚铁盐在较强的氧化剂作用: 2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻: iron(II) salts are oxidized to iron(III) salts by stronger oxidizing agents (textbook wording + ionic equation).
A2.13、A2.14、B2.8、标准值表 14–15、D5: A2.13, A2.14, B2.8, standard values tables 14–15, D5
「+2 价」和「+3 价」之间，到底丢了什么、又拿回了什么？: Between "+2" and "+3", what exactly is lost and then regained?
看放大窗里 Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 的粒子怎么换、电子往哪走（回去再拖一次铁粉: Watch how the Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ particles swap and where the electrons go in the magnified window (go back and try iron powder / chlorine water once each)
放大窗里 Fe²⁺ 8 个 / Fe³⁺ 0 个（加铁粉后）↔ Fe³⁺ 8 个: Magnified window: 8 Fe²⁺ / 0 Fe³⁺ (after iron powder) ↔ 8 Fe³⁺ / 0 Fe²⁺ (after chlorine water); the total particle count stays the same; with iron powder electrons flow into Fe³⁺, with chlorine water electrons flow out of Fe²⁺
价态不是「贴上去的标签」，就是电子的个数。: Oxidation state isn't a label stuck on; it's the electron count.
换价态 = 换电子，所以必须有「能给出电子」或「能拿走电子」的另一方。: Changing the state means changing electrons, so there must be another party that "can give electrons" or "can take them".
铁原子总数不变，变的只是每个铁原子手上的电子数——这就是为什么 φ 能来回走而总: The number of iron atoms stays the same; only the electrons each iron atom holds change. That's why φ can go back and forth while the total stays fixed.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「加铁粉还原、加氯水氧化」，不知道还原与氧化到底动了什么。: Skip this step and students only memorize "iron powder reduces, chlorine water oxidizes", without knowing what reduction and oxidation actually move.
高频：氧化还原的电子转移方向；Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 的价态差。: Frequently tested: direction of electron transfer in redox; the state difference between Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺.
Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 之间只差 1 个电子：Fe − 2e⁻ → Fe²⁺、F: Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ differ by only 1 electron: Fe − 2e⁻ → Fe²⁺, Fe − 3e⁻ → Fe³⁺; losing electrons is oxidation, gaining electrons is reduction (textbook wording).

The standard tube on the right (FeCl₃) turns red either way

错误操作链：不加稀硝酸就滴 KSCN → 不变红 → 误判「不含铁」。: Wrong chain of steps: KSCN without dilute nitric acid → no red → wrong conclusion "no iron".
错在第 4 步那条：KSCN 只认 Fe³⁺，「不变红」只说明没有 Fe³⁺。: It fails at step 4's rule: KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, so "no red" only shows there's no Fe³⁺.
教材的方案写得很清楚：先加少量稀硝酸（它「具有氧化性」），再滴 KSCN；补铁剂: The textbook method is clear: first add a little dilute nitric acid (it is "oxidizing"), then add KSCN. Iron supplements are another sample type for the same method (vitamin C is reducing and pulls Fe³⁺ back to Fe²⁺, which is why supplements are often taken with it).
去掉这一步：学生会把「KSCN 不变红」当成「没有铁」，考到食品、脱氧剂、补铁剂: Skip this step and students treat "KSCN not red" as "no iron", getting every food, oxygen-absorber and supplement question wrong.
高频：检验食品或补铁剂中的铁元素为什么先加稀硝酸（或氯水）；「不变红」能推出什么: Frequently tested: why dilute nitric acid (or chlorine water) is added first when testing food or supplements for iron; what "no red" lets you conclude.
KSCN 只认 Fe³⁺，而食品里的铁大部分是 Fe²⁺，所以要先加少量稀硝酸（: KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, and most iron in food is Fe²⁺, so first add a little dilute nitric acid (which is oxidizing) to oxidize Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, then add KSCN (textbook research & practice plan). Iron supplements are often taken with vitamin C because it is reducing (ascorbic acid acts as an antioxidant by being oxidized itself), turning oxidized Fe³⁺ back into Fe²⁺.

在 FeSO₄ 溶液中滴入 NaOH，白色沉淀迅速变灰绿、最后变红褐，原因是: When NaOH is added to FeSO₄ solution, the white precipitate quickly turns grey-green and finally red-brown because
白色 Fe(OH)₂ 被溶解在溶液中的氧气氧化成 Fe(OH)₃: White Fe(OH)₂ is oxidized to Fe(OH)₃ by oxygen dissolved in the solution
沉淀溶解后又重新析出: The precipitate dissolved and then re-formed
教材原话：白色的氢氧化亚铁［Fe(OH)₂］被溶解在溶液中的氧气氧化成了红褐色的: Textbook wording: white iron(II) hydroxide [Fe(OH)₂] is oxidized by oxygen dissolved in the solution to red-brown iron(III) hydroxide [Fe(OH)₃], 4Fe(OH)₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O = 4Fe(OH)₃. This lesson computed: after 60 s open, 69.9 % is already oxidized and the color is red-brown.
要在实验室里看到并保持 Fe(OH)₂ 的白色，下列做法无效的是: To see and keep the white of Fe(OH)₂ in the lab, which of these does NOT help?
把蒸馏水煮沸赶走溶解氧: Boil the distilled water to drive off dissolved oxygen
用长滴管把 NaOH 伸到液面下滴加: Add NaOH with a long dropper below the surface
在液面上加一层煤油: Add a layer of kerosene on the surface
把试管放在酒精灯上加热，让它更热: Heat the test tube over an alcohol lamp to make it hotter
白色消失是被 O₂ 氧化，与温度无关，加热反而加快氧化。本课算过：隔绝空气后同样: The white disappears through oxidation by O₂, which has nothing to do with temperature; heating actually speeds up oxidation. This lesson computed: with air excluded, only 4.7 % is oxidized after the same 60 s (still white), versus 69.9 % open (red-brown).
向某溶液中滴加 KSCN 溶液后不变红，可以得出的结论是: After adding KSCN to a solution it doesn't turn red. What can you conclude?
该溶液中一定不含铁元素: The solution certainly contains no iron
该溶液一定是亚铁盐溶液: The solution must be an iron(II) salt solution
教材原话：含有 Fe³⁺ 的盐溶液遇到 KSCN 溶液时变成红色，可以利用这一反: Textbook wording: salt solutions containing Fe³⁺ turn red with KSCN, and this reaction tests for Fe³⁺. KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, so "no red" only shows there is no Fe³⁺. It doesn't show there's no iron, nor that it must be Fe²⁺. Step 8 of this lesson falls into exactly this trap.
向 FeCl₃ 溶液中加入过量铁粉，充分反应后溶液的价态与浓度变化是: Excess iron powder is added to FeCl₃ solution. After full reaction, the state and concentration change is
Fe³⁺ 全部变成 Fe²⁺，c(Fe²⁺) 是原 c(Fe³⁺) 的 1.5: All Fe³⁺ becomes Fe²⁺, and c(Fe²⁺) is 1.5 times the original c(Fe³⁺)
Fe³⁺ 全部变成 Fe²⁺，c(Fe²⁺) 与原 c(Fe³⁺) 相等: All Fe³⁺ becomes Fe²⁺, and c(Fe²⁺) equals the original c(Fe³⁺)
Fe³⁺ 不变，只是颜色变浅: Fe³⁺ is unchanged; only the color gets lighter
Fe³⁺ 变成 Fe，有铁析出: Fe³⁺ becomes Fe, and iron is deposited
2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺：2 mol Fe³⁺ 变成 3 mol F: 2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺: 2 mol Fe³⁺ becomes 3 mol Fe²⁺, so 1.5 times. This lesson computed: 50 mmol/L FeCl₃ with excess iron powder becomes 75 mmol/L Fe²⁺, and KSCN no longer turns red.
在上面那支管的浅绿色清液里滴加氯水，再滴 KSCN，现象与价态变化是: Chlorine water is added to the pale green liquid from that tube, then KSCN. The observations and state change are
溶液变棕黄、滴 KSCN 变红，Fe²⁺ 被氧化成 Fe³⁺: The solution turns yellow-brown and red with KSCN; Fe²⁺ is oxidized to Fe³⁺
溶液仍浅绿、滴 KSCN 不变红，Fe²⁺ 没变: The solution stays pale green and doesn't turn red with KSCN; Fe²⁺ is unchanged
溶液变棕黄但滴 KSCN 不变红: The solution turns yellow-brown but doesn't turn red with KSCN
2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻：氯水是较强氧化剂，把 Fe: 2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻: chlorine water is a stronger oxidizer that oxidizes Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, so the color goes from pale green to yellow-brown and KSCN turns red again. This lesson computed: c(Fe³⁺) goes from 0 back to 75 mmol/L, 50 % higher than the original 50.
按教材的方法检验食品中的铁元素时，先加少量稀硝酸再滴 KSCN，原因是: When testing food for iron by the textbook method, dilute nitric acid is added before KSCN because
稀硝酸能把 Fe³⁺ 还原成 Fe²⁺: Dilute nitric acid reduces Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺
稀硝酸具有氧化性，把 Fe²⁺ 氧化成 Fe³⁺，才能被 KSCN 检出: Dilute nitric acid is oxidizing and turns Fe²⁺ into Fe³⁺, which KSCN can then detect
稀硝酸只是用来调节酸碱性: Dilute nitric acid only adjusts the acidity
稀硝酸能把铁元素沉淀出来: Dilute nitric acid precipitates the iron
教材原话：加入少量稀硝酸（稀硝酸具有氧化性），再滴加几滴 KSCN 溶液。KSC: Textbook wording: add a little dilute nitric acid (dilute nitric acid is oxidizing), then a few drops of KSCN solution. KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, and most iron in food is Fe²⁺. This lesson computed: without dilute nitric acid φ is only 5.0 %, red intensity 0.03 (barely visible); with it, 100.0 % and 0.60 (clearly red).
